title: 第7章
content:
没几天以后，骆非约我吃饭，说是几个朋友聚一聚。我下意识地就想到那天咖啡厅门口的男人，知道他肯定也会在。不过骆非问我去不去的时候，我答应了。反正也没什么好避讳的。主要原因是我已经推了骆非大概八次的吃饭邀请了，我怕他哪天生气了拿枪顶我脑袋逼我去。他果然来了，一进包厢，熟识的几个朋友都纷纷跟他打招呼，看起来人缘相当好。听骆非说，他之前待在国外，回国以后都在另一个城市，上个月刚来a市打理一个分公司。他跟在场另两个不熟识的人自我介绍，说他叫傅斯澄。真巧，我最恨姓傅的。又很巧，就我身边有个空位，于是他大大方方地走过来坐下了。“梁暖。”他叫我。“嗯。”我懒洋洋地拿着酒杯应了声。其他人已经在胡侃喝酒了，包厢里热闹又吵闹，他怕我听不清，于是稍稍凑过来跟我说话。他身上有很好闻的味道，在满房的酒气和菜香里像是格格不入却出众诱人的一种吸引，让我对他的靠近也没了抵触。他说了什么我依旧没听清，于是转过头问他：“你说什么？”他的眉眼近在咫尺，距离暧昧，可是他的脸上却带着不掺杂质的笑，他似乎很爱笑，而且那笑容完全不让人讨厌。他的眼睛很黑很黑，瞳色浓深，看人时总会给人一种专註深情的错觉。他说：“你今天可不可以给我微信了？”他的态度那么明显，来来去去却偏偏只要我当面给他一个微信，不知道到底是装纯还是什么勾搭人的新型手段。但是今天我乐意吃这一套，因为我刚刚喝了不少酒，我这人酒精一上头就心胸开阔很好糊弄，路过街道办都会伸手掏兜儿拿钱募捐的那种。“给啊。”我听见自己说，“你要什么我给什么。”他像是对这句充满暗示性的话毫无反应，依旧是轻轻笑着，拿起纸巾擦着我拿着酒杯的左手手背，上面有几滴刚刚不小心洒出杯子的酒。“就要一个微信。”他说。他擦手也擦得单纯，只是拿着纸巾碰着我的手背，一点肌肤接触都没有。这招数真的不错，因为搞得我很想直接把手递到他的手心里让他握着给我擦干凈。我觉得我大概是低估傅斯澄了，他比我想象中的还有一套。好烦，要打炮就直说，我又不是不同意，何必搞得这么循序渐进。如果我知道跟傅斯澄打完炮以后他会变成那副粘人不要脸的样子，说什么我也不会跟他上床，并且一定会穿越回来给此时的我一个大嘴巴子。那是之后的事了，说什么都晚了，f**k。我头晕，一手托腮一手拿起手机点开微信二维码，推到他身前：“加吧。”

他拿出手机加了微信，然后拿过我面前的酒：“别喝了，看你都有点不清醒了。”我笑了一下，不置可否，有点无聊地吃着水果。那群人聊着聊着就聊起我的破事儿，又开始例行地打趣我。“梁暖，什么时候再穿次小裙子瞧瞧啊？”“真的，特别好看，我们诚心邀请你再穿穿。”“好暖暖，再穿一回吧，我们当时不知道你在搞直播，要是知道了，肯定给你打赏，把你送上平臺热榜。”我抬起眼皮，拿起一颗桂圆朝开启话头的那个人扔了过去：“喝你的酒，再废话拉你去做裸体直播。”席上人嘻嘻哈哈地笑起来，一群朋友，调笑成性，没有恶意，我也乐意跟他们插科打诨。傅斯澄似乎也不知不觉地喝了不少酒，他一直笑着看着我，眼里像是含着水，没有半分凌厉和轻佻，反倒温润得不像话。啊呀，你这该死的温柔。我把手机装进兜里，起身打了个招呼：“去趟洗手间。”“少来。”骆非靠在椅子上看我，“我们还不了解你，又准备趁去洗手间的时候开溜吧？”我耸耸肩，不以为意道：“被你看出来了，那就先跟你们说声再见，我回去了。”我出了包厢，揉了揉太阳穴，想着先去洗把脸，再打个车回去，这里离我的小区近，饭前我是走路过来的，当时还顺便去咖啡厅走了个过场，被店里几个青春洋溢的服务员好生振奋鼓舞了一番，让我不要那么丧，多一点笑容，多一点阳光。我说：“我多一点阳光，你们就少一点工资，再废话下班时间延迟一小时。”于是他们终于安静如鸡地干活了。没走两步，我听见傅斯澄叫我：“梁暖。”我往墻上一靠，回过头，不用猜也知道我现在脸上的表情肯定是似笑非笑的：“什么事？”“你没开车是吗？我送你吧。”他走到我身前，认真地看着我。“你不是也喝了酒么？”“有司机。”他见我靠在墻上，于是伸手扶我，“头晕吗？会不会想吐？”我实在很受不了这种关心，摆摆手：“没事儿，我就想洗把脸。”我们一起进了洗手间，我随便洗了把脸，抬头看镜子时看到傅斯澄正侧身看着我，镜子里的他只露出一个侧脸，很是好看。他把纸巾递给我，声音轻柔：“擦一下脸上的水。”我对着镜子看了几秒钟，转头问他：“做不做？”作者有话说：ps：tararus发表于2019-4-1813:24大大是开坑了嘛，刚看过隔壁的文，惊喜！！！是滴！！！！

A few days later, Luo Fei invited me to dinner, saying it was a get-together with some friends.I subconsciously thought of the man at the door of the coffee shop that day, knowing that he would definitely be there too.But when Luo Fei asked me if I would go, I agreed.There is nothing to avoid anyway.The main reason is that I have already extended Luo Fei's dinner invitation about eight times. I'm afraid that one day he will get angry and put a gun to my head and force me to go.Sure enough, he came. As soon as he entered the box, several familiar friends greeted him one after another. He seemed to be quite popular.Luo Fei said that he had been abroad before and had been in another city since returning to China. He just came to City A last month to manage a branch.He introduced himself to two other strangers present and said his name was Fu Sicheng.What a coincidence, I hate people named Fu the most.By coincidence, there was an empty seat next to me, so he walked over and sat down generously."Liang Nuan." He called me."Yeah." I responded lazily, holding the wine glass.Others were already talking and drinking, and the box was lively and noisy. He was afraid that I couldn't hear clearly, so he came over to talk to me.He smelled very good, and it seemed to be an incompatible yet attractive attraction amidst the smell of wine and vegetables in the room, which made me no longer resist his approach.I still didn't hear what he said clearly, so I turned around and asked him, "What did you say?" His eyebrows and eyes were close at hand, but the distance was ambiguous, but there was an unadulterated smile on his face. He seemed to love to laugh, and that smile was not annoying at all.His eyes are very dark and intense, giving people the illusion of being focused and affectionate when he looks at people.He said: "Can you give me WeChat today?" His attitude was so obvious, but he always wanted me to give him WeChat in person. I don't know if it was just pretending to be innocent or some new way of hooking up with people.But today I am willing to do this, because I just drank a lot of wine, and I am open-minded and easy to fool when I am drunk. I will reach into my pocket to collect money for donations when I pass by the street office."Here." I heard myself saying, "I'll give you whatever you want." He seemed to have no reaction to the suggestive words. He still smiled softly and picked up a tissue to wipe the back of my left hand holding the wine glass. There were a few drops of wine on it that had just accidentally spilled the glass.“Just a WeChat account,” he said.He wiped his hands simply. He just touched the back of my hand with a tissue, without any skin contact.This trick was really good, because it made me want to put my hand directly into his palm and let him hold it and wipe it clean for me.I think I may have underestimated Fu Sicheng. He is more sophisticated than I thought.It's so annoying. If you want to have sex, just say so. It's not like I don't agree with it. Why do it have to be so gradual?If I had known that after having sex with Fu Sicheng, he would become so clingy and shameless, I would never go to bed with him no matter what, and he would definitely come back in time and give me a big mouth at this time.That’s happening later, it’s too late to say anything, f**k.I was dizzy. I held my chin in one hand and picked up my phone with the other, clicked on the WeChat QR code, and pushed it in front of him: "Add it."

He took out his mobile phone and added WeChat, and then took the wine in front of me: "Stop drinking, I see you're a little sober." I smiled, noncommittal, and ate the fruit a little bored.The group of people chatted about my bad things and started making fun of me as usual."Liang Nuan, when are you going to wear a little skirt again?" "Really, it looks really good. We sincerely invite you to wear it again." "So Nuan Nuan, please wear it again. We didn't know you were doing live broadcasts at the time. If we knew, we would definitely give you a reward and put you on the hot list of the platform."I raised my eyelids, picked up a longan and threw it at the person who started the conversation: "Drink your wine, and I will talk nonsense to you to do a naked live broadcast." The people at the table laughed. They were a group of friends who were joking and had no malice. I was also happy to make jokes with them.Fu Sicheng seemed to have drunk a lot of wine without knowing it. He kept looking at me with a smile, and his eyes seemed to be filled with water. He was not sharp or frivolous at all, but rather gentle and gentle.Oh, you are so damn gentle.I put my phone in my pocket, stood up and said hello: "Go to the bathroom." "Don't come here." Luo Fei leaned on the chair and looked at me, "We don't know you yet, are we going to run away while going to the bathroom?" I shrugged and said indifferently: "You saw it, so I'll say goodbye to you first, I'm going back." I said.I got into the private room, rubbed my temples, and thought about washing my face first, and then taking a taxi back. This place is close to my community. I walked here before the meal. I also stopped by the coffee shop for a walk. I was cheered up by several young waiters in the store, who told me not to be so depressed, to smile more, and to be more sunny.I said: "If I get more sunshine, you will get less salary, and if you don't talk nonsense, your get off work will be delayed by one hour." So they finally worked quietly as a chicken.Before I had taken two steps, I heard Fu Sicheng call me: "Liang Nuan." I leaned against the wall and turned around. You didn't need to guess to know that the expression on my face must be a smile but not a smile: "What's the matter?" "You're not driving, right? I'll give you a ride." He walked up to me and looked at me seriously."Aren't you drunk too?" "There is a driver." He saw me leaning against the wall, so he stretched out his hand to help me, "Are you dizzy? Do you feel like vomiting?" I really couldn't bear the concern, so I waved my hand: "It's okay, I just want to wash my face." We entered the bathroom together, and I washed my face casually. When I looked up in the mirror, I saw Fu Sicheng looking at me sideways. In the mirror, he only showed one side of his face, which was very nice.He handed me the tissue and said in a soft voice: "Wipe the water on your face." I looked at the mirror for a few seconds, turned around and asked him: "Do you want to do it?" The author has something to say: ps: tararus posted on 2019-4-1813:24 This is a big mistake. I just read the article next door, and I was pleasantly surprised!!!Yes!!!!
